# Plan: Chapter Capture v1

<!-- Generated by wave-plan from docs/waves/specs/*.md. The specs own the "what" (depends_on,
     owns, acceptance criteria); this file owns the "when and how". Do not restate spec fields
     freehand: edit the spec and regenerate. Machine-readable data lives only in the fenced
     blocks below (flow-style YAML, one line per field); everything else is for humans. -->

Chapter's own LiDAR capture: an iPhone/iPad Pro app that produces the full intake package from
`docs/waves/context/intake-guide-R01.md`, a station on Azure that checks it automatically, HUB
publishing, and a web review screen. Context: `docs/waves/context/architecture.md`.
Design: `docs/waves/design/DESIGN.md` (frozen 2026-10-17).

## Header

```yaml header
design: docs/waves/design/snapshot.html
bootstrap: "if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; fi && if [ -x scripts/bootstrap-swift.sh ]; then scripts/bootstrap-swift.sh; fi"
gates: {format: "npm run format:check", lint: "npm run lint", typecheck: "npm run typecheck", unit: "npm test"}
max_wave_width: 8
```
